title: File:Wessel & Vett Fashion Prize - 10 år med Danmarks største modepris 06.jpg
desc: Temporary exhibition in Magasin du Nord Museum in Copenhagen about the Wessel & Vett Fashion Prize which celebrated it's 10 years anniversary in 2022. Cecilie Bahnsen won the prize in 2016 and 2020.
